title: HDSG Composed VLM Caption v1
description: A caption composed by the generative layer in its own words, together with a declaration of every numeric value it stated and the fact each one came from. Declaration is what makes the release gate's comparison exact: the model states the attribution, so the gate compares declared values with measured ones rather than recovering a number from prose and inferring which fact it refers to. The record carries no action field, so the model cannot set or alter the action tuple.

caption.description: The composed text. Deliberately unconstrained in shape, because the design requires the model to compose language rather than select from responses written in advance. What it may contain is established by the release gate, not by this schema.

assertions.description: One entry for every numeric value the caption states. A numeral in the caption with no entry here is rejected, so a value the model invented cannot reach the display by being omitted.

stated_value.description: The value as written into the caption. The release gate compares it against the measurement exactly, on the text as the deterministic renderer would display it, and rejects the candidate on any difference. There is no tolerance and no second acceptable spelling of the same value: a measurement displayed as 1.74 metres is accepted only as 1.74, and both 1.7449 and 1.7 are refused. The tolerance this field described until 23 August 2026 was removed when exactness on the written token replaced it.

proposed_label.description: Lower case words separated by single spaces. The pattern held a character class containing a space until 23 August 2026, which admitted a trailing space and a run of spaces that the grammar has always refused; the label is rendered as prose, so a trailing space reached the display as a double space.
